text: When the causes for the attainment of merits and other such qualities are absent, the soul remains in the body sustained by the power of latent impressions (samskaras). Why does the destruction of current merits and demerits not [immediately] occur through knowledge? Because of their current nature, they reach destruction in a moment. Knowledge, however, burns the future (unmanifested) karma. Furthermore, whatever is performed with the current body is [exhausted] through the performance of prescribed duties. Thus, upon the destruction of latent impressions and the falling away of the body, liberation is attained.
